```yaml name: PR Preview Artifact on: pull_request: paths: - 'website/**' workflow_dispatch: jobs: build-and-deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v2 - name: Set up .NET Core uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2 with: dotnet-version: '6.0' - name: Build project run: dotnet build website --configuration Release --no-restore - name: Publish website run: dotnet publish website --configuration Release --output ./publish - name: Upload artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2 with: name: website-preview path: ./publish retention-days: 30 - name: Check if Cloudflare secrets are set id: check-secrets run: | echo "CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV shell: bash - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages (optional) if: env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN && env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID run: | npx wrangler pages dev ./publish --project-name razorconsole-preview --local-port 8080 shell: bash - name: Post PR comment id: post-comment uses: actions/github-script@v4 with: github-token: ${{ github.token }} script: | const pr = context.payload.pull_request; const artifactUrl = `https://api.github.com/repos/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.name}/actions/artifacts/website-preview/download`; const cloudflareLink = process.env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN ? 'https://razorconsole.pages.dev' : ''; const commentBody = `
Preview Deployment

Website changes have been deployed. Download the preview from here.

${cloudflareLink ? `

Live preview available at ${cloudflareLink}

` : ''}
`; await github.rest.issues.createComment({ owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.name, issue_number: pr.number, body: commentBody }); ``` This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a combined preview workflow for PRs that modify the `website` directory. It triggers on changes to files within the `website` directory or manually via workflow dispatch. The workflow builds the website, publishes it, and uploads it as a GitHub Actions artifact with a 30-day retention policy. If Cloudflare secrets (`CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`) are configured, it also optionally deploys the website to Cloudflare Pages. Finally, it posts a comment to the PR with instructions on how to download the preview artifact and, if applicable, access the live preview.
